profile_text.body:
Google is a public company founded in 1998 and headquartered in Mountain View, CA, whose primary consumer-facing AI presence is centered on Gemini, described on its own site as an AI assistant intended to help with writing, planning, brainstorming, and related tasks. The company trades on public markets under the ticker GOOGL and reported revenue of $402,836,000,000 for the period ending 2025-12-31, as filed on a 10-K with CIK 0001652044.

Google's tracked AI product portfolio spans several categories. Gemini serves as a general large language model assistant, while Google AI Studio is offered for model prototyping. NotebookLM is a document-grounded tool that ingests uploaded corpora. Google Meet AI and Google Drive AI bring meeting summaries, live captions, note-taking, and Gemini integration into the Google Workspace environment. On the healthcare side, Google Med-PaLM and MedLM are described as medical large language models focused on clinical reasoning and healthcare data, with a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement noted as required. TensorFlow and Keras, the open-source machine learning frameworks, round out the portfolio alongside TensorFlow Extended for MLOps use cases.

No litigation cases or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for Google at this time.
